comparison.objective: Remove an interrupted suture using forceps and a cutter; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block between supports.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires knot lifting, flush cutting, directional extraction and two-instrument coordination. Candidate requires rail–jig alignment, force-limited sliding and continuous ball support.
comparison.success_condition: Record grades correct lift, cut location, extraction direction, disposal and instrument return while avoiding tissue hazards. Candidate grades complete transfer and preservation of every rolling element without gaps, contamination or damage.
comparison.reason: The mechanisms, manipulation sequence and failure modes are unrelated beyond generic bimanual coordination.
